task: Predict probability that next observed adjusted close-to-close return is strictly positive. Zero returns are not-up, not labeled as a decline.
selection: Select convex logistic/neural ensemble weight from 0,.25,.5,.75,1 using prior-year validation log loss; refit on all pre-test labels. All other settings fixed.
models: L2 logistic regression; 16-unit ReLU neural classifier with sigmoid output, binary cross entropy and Adam, 20 epochs, seed 42.
baseline: Pre-test historical up frequency; always-up decision baseline; 50/50 probability reference; train-only conditional momentum baseline.
metrics: Primary log loss; secondary accuracy at fixed .5 threshold, balanced accuracy, ROC AUC and Brier score. Calibration table with fixed bins.
uncertainty: Paired daily average log-loss gains over historical up-frequency baseline, circular moving-block bootstrap: 2000 draws, blocks 5/10/20 sessions.
scope: Exploratory retrospective reuse of a previously inspected dataset. No fresh confirmatory holdout, trading strategy, live trading or profit claim. No test-driven retries.
